items.title: NorthShore Health Centers

items.cause: unauthorized network access by unknown actor per entity; ransomware/extortion claim REPORTED

items.title: ARcare, Inc. (2022 breach) - class action settlement
items.status: CONFIRMED (settlement, preliminary approval); REPORTED (class size, claim deadline, revised hearing date)
items.summary: Hale v. ARcare, E.D. Ark. 3:22-cv-00117-BSM: $3,900,000 non-reversionary fund; preliminary approval order dated 2026-08-03. Reported: ~345,000 notified; claims due 2027-01-07; final approval hearing moved to 2027-01-28.
items.fqhc_verified: Community Health Centers of Arkansas member; HRSA UDS awardee
items.litigation: $3.9M class settlement, preliminary approval 2026-08-03; final approval pending

items.title: HHS OCR settlement with Lehigh Valley Health Network
items.summary: Announced 2026-10-29: $800,000 and 3-year corrective action plan; ransomware discovered 2023-02-04; 248,359 individuals; findings include no accurate and thorough risk analysis, no regular review of system activity, late breach notification. OCR's 22nd ransomware enforcement action. Not an FQHC; alerted under rule 3.

items.title: CISA KEV: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527
items.summary: Added to KEV 2026-10-30 on evidence of active exploitation. SSL VPN / remote access product.

items.title: CISA KEV: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868
items.summary: Added to KEV 2026-11-06. Use of single-factor authentication vulnerability in SSLVPN. Reported (BleepingComputer): allows bypass of SAML-enforced MFA.

items.title: CISA KEV: Barracuda Email Security Gateway CVE-2026-116606 and multiple-product CVE-2026-111560; Microsoft Outlook CVE-2026-124194
items.summary: Added to KEV 2026-11-10. ESG authentication bypass chained with OS command injection (root); due date 2026-11-13 with forensic triage required. Same alert adds an Outlook flaw.
